row: Welcome to my channel. After modelling full time all over the world i decided to prioritise my life with my one true passion, horses. In my weekly vlogs I share my life with horses, the beautiful places they take me, and the lessons they continue to teach me every day. We have also embarked on a huge renovation of our 40 acre estate in the Netherlands… so be ready for home content, gardening and everything in between.
